semantics_change: contract 8 -> 9: the phase field is transported on the embedded cut-cell control volumes of the same corner reconstruction that defines the wall measure. Q_i = V_i phi_i with V_i the exact fluid polygon area, shared partial face apertures A_f (open length), w_f = A_f/d_ij, wall density A_wall,i/V_i, and an Euclidean-SPD matrix-free CG on I + dt M eps S^2 with S = V^-1/2 K V^-1/2 instead of a Euclidean CG on the nonsymmetric V^-1 K. g_w, h(phi), sigma_0, M, dt, eps, the measurement reference plane, Brinkman, gas properties and the CG tolerance are unchanged; there is no fitted factor and no mass projection. phase_transport_geometry='hard_cell_v7' reproduces contract 8 for falsification.

preflight_exceptions.scope: development preflight only: not a physics acceptance waiver and not a CI pass. Two-phase unit/E2E smoke checks passed on the L1A-2d PR; its Quality job failed at 'Audit locked dependencies'.

translation.description: primary alignment gate: eight sub-cell wall offsets at fixed domain/N/theta, each to convergence, measured against the true geometric sdf = 0 wall

translation_v8.description: pinned contract-7/8 transport (hard_cell_v7) re-measured under the v9 code: the reproduction guard for the A/B claim

resolution.description: same physical wall at N = 96/128/192 (L1A-2e measured a 3.093 deg spread at 150 deg)

primary_float64.description: formal four-target CH-only matrix in float64 with rtol = 1e-8

production_mobility.description: the same equilibria at the production mobility M_ref

precision.description: N-CH-MASS-PRECISION matrix at equal mobility-scaled time, mass measured as sum_i V_i phi_i

chns.description: full CHNS at production defaults (M_ref, dt = 4e-3, N = 128, eps = 2dx)

laplace.description: static-droplet pressure jump on the empty solid: the cut-cell geometry must degenerate exactly, so the v9/v8 ratio stays 1

impact.description: droplet impact regression plus the cut-cell advective CFL diagnostic; no geometry tuning to morphology

forbidden_production_corrections: global mass projection or post-step redistribution
stopping_rules: flux redistribution or complex cell merging would be required for the cut-cell advective CFL => STOP and defer to the next stage
a listed hard-fail condition fires => declare L1A-2f NOT READY
the post-v9 angle error still tracks the old hard-mask plane offset => report the hypothesis as falsified
